cases.name: or-first
cases.body:
let n=1
return match n {1 or 2 => 10, _ => 20}

cases.name: or-second
cases.body:
let n=2
return match n {1 or 2 => 10, _ => 20}

cases.name: or-fallback
cases.body:
let n=3
return match n {1 or 2 => 10, _ => 20}

cases.name: or-three
cases.body:
let n=3
return match n {1 or 2 or 3 => 10, _ => 20}

negative.name: or-mixed
negative.body:
let n=1
return match n {1 or 2 @@and 3 => 10, _ => 20}
